# Fst calculations

# Snake genotype data
```{r}

```


## Observed genotype data
```{r}
genotypes <- data.frame(
  genotype = rep(c("n_AA", "n_Aa", "n_aa"),2),
  site = c(rep("S1",6), rep("S2",6)),
  EW = rep(c(rep("W",3), rep("E",3)),2),
  freq_obs = c(14,8,3,4,4,12,10,15,8,6,10,8)
)
genotypes
```
## Calculate Allele frequencies
```{r}
genotypes |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = genotype, values_from = freq_obs) |>
  mutate(N = (AA + Aa + aa),
         AA_o = n_AA / N,
         Aa_o = n_Aa / N,
         aa_o = n_aa,
         p = (2 * AA + Aa) / (2*N),
         q = (2 * aa + Aa) / (2*N),
         AA_e = p^2,
         Aa_e = 2 * p * q,
         aa_e = q^2,
         Fst = 1 - Aa_o / Aa_e)

```



```{r}
AA_o<- 22
Aa_o <- 38
aa_o <- 20
observed <- c(AA_o, Aa_o, aa_o)
N <- AA + Aa + aa
```

## Calculate allele frequencies
```{r}
p <- (2*AA_o + Aa_o)/(2*N)
q <- (2*aa_o + Aa_o)/(2*N)
```

## Calculate Expected Genotype Frequencies
```{r}
fAA_e <- p*p
fAa_e <- 2*p*q
faa_e <- q*q
f_expected <- c(fAA_e, fAa_e, faa_e)
```

## Calculate Expected Genotype Numbers
```{r}
AA_e <- N * fAA_e
Aa_e <- N * fAa_e
aa_e <- N * faa_e
expected <- c(AA_e, Aa_e, aa_e)
```

# Do we deviate from HWE?
```{r}
chisq.test(observed, p = f_expected)
```
